assistant.title: Field assistant
assistant.adminNotice: Farm admins can read every conversation on this farm.
assistant.adviceOnly: The assistant advises only. It never changes your records, calendar or inventory.
assistant.readOnlyThread: {name}'s conversation. You can read it but not reply.
assistant.offline: You are offline. Past conversations can be read; new questions need a connection.

suggest.alert: What should I do about the {domain} alert on {block}?
suggest.recommendation: Why does the card “{title}” recommend this?
suggest.frostWeek: Is there a frost risk for {block} this week?
suggest.scoutNow: What should I scout for on {block} now?

assistant.deleteConfirm: Delete this conversation? This cannot be undone.

errors.unavailable: The assistant is not available right now. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.limit_user: You have reached today's limit of questions. Try again tomorrow.
errors.limit_farm: This farm has reached today's limit of questions. Try again tomorrow.
errors.bad_request: That question could not be sent.
errors.forbidden: You do not have access to the assistant on this farm.
errors.not_configured: The assistant is not set up yet.
errors.not_found: This farm could not be found.

decline.veterinary: I can't advise on animal health. Please contact a veterinarian.
decline.medical: I can't give medical advice. If someone is unwell or may have been exposed to a chemical, contact a doctor or a poison centre, and in an emergency call the emergency number.
decline.legal: I can't give legal advice. Please consult a lawyer.
decline.financial: I can't give financial advice. Please consult a financial adviser.
decline.circumvention: I can't do that. I follow the same rules for every question: this farm's own data, guides for its crop and variety, and the system's calculations.
decline.pesticide_no_regulatory: I can't name a pesticide product or dose for this farm: no regulatory source for your country is loaded in the knowledge base. Check the product label, or ask a licensed plant-protection adviser.
decline.off_topic: I can only help with running this farm.

assistant.doseRemoved: A pesticide product or dose was removed from this answer because no regulatory source for your country backs it. Check the product label or ask a licensed adviser.
assistant.figureUnchecked: Note: a figure in this answer could not be matched to the farm's data or the guides. Check it before acting on it.
assistant.couldNotAnswer: I couldn't produce a reliable answer to that. Try rephrasing it, or pin a block.

drafts.label: Draft card
drafts.title: Title
drafts.accepted: Accepted and booked on the calendar
drafts.acceptedEdited: Accepted with changes and booked on the calendar
drafts.readOnly: This farm is read-only while its subscription is overdue, so cards cannot be accepted.
drafts.failed: That did not work. Try again.

guides.explain: This sends your question to the RootLoot team so they can look for guides that cover it. They will see the question and your farm's name.
guides.limit: This farm already has several open questions with the RootLoot team. Try again once they are answered.
guides.failed: The request could not be sent. Try again.

irrigate.rationale: The irrigation calculation of {date} shows {depletion} mm used of {raw} mm readily available water in the root zone. It calls for {mm} mm ({m3} m³); days until the irrigation threshold: {days}.

share.explain: This lets the RootLoot support team read this one conversation for 14 days, for example to look into a wrong answer. Your other conversations stay private. You can withdraw it at any time, and each time support opens it is logged.
share.failed: That did not work. Try again.
